scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.join(__dirname,'node_modules','pdfjs-dist','build','pdf.worker.min.mjs'); const dst=path.join(__dirname,'public','pdf.worker.min.mjs'); if(!fs.existsSync(path.join(__dirname,'public'))){fs.mkdirSync(path.join(__dirname,'public'),{recursive:true});} if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(src,dst); console.log('PDF worker copiado para public/');}"
